name: @alalanet/x402-guard
description: Asks alalanet before an x402 payment is signed, in the official x402 client hook (one line for @x402/fetch, @x402/axios, @x402/mcp) or as a fetch wrapper: blocks unknown payTo, bait-and-switch prices and sanctioned addresses; per-call, daily and per-seller budgets; the wrapper also never pays twice for one purchase; warns about x402 SDK versions with known flaws.
author: alalanet <noreply@alalanet.com>
